guarantees.claim: Parameter AppDigestW is assigned the constant value 384.
Parameter AppKeyW is assigned the constant value 256.
app_req_t struct includes fields valid, data of width MsgWidth, strb of width MsgStrbW, and last.
app_rsp_t struct includes fields ready, done, digest_share0 of width 384, digest_share1 of width 384, and error.

uncertain_points.claim: Comment in app_rsp_t states that upon error, KMAC returns garbage digest data. This may leak internal kmac state (e.g., intermediate digest shares).
uncertain_points.cond: When done is high and error is high, digest_share0/digest_share1 may contain garbage from internal processing.
uncertain_points.risk: Exposure of secret kmac state through the digest share outputs on error.

uncertain_points.claim: Comment asserts 'Error is valid when done is high', but no hardware enforcement is defined in this structural declaration.
uncertain_points.cond: Unclear if the module generating app_rsp_t actually enforces this timing.
uncertain_points.risk: If error is asserted without done, downstream corruption or misinterpretation could occur.
